Container.Name: media-review
Container.Overview: Friends who use your Plex server Downvote movies and shows they think should go. When enough of the people who have actually tried a title agree, it goes to the Review Queue, and you decide Keep or Remove in Media Ops. Nothing is removed automatically. Set Network Type to the same custom network as Plex and Tautulli, so the addresses below can use their container names. Built on the linuxserver.io Alpine base image (PUID/PGID/UMASK/TZ).

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web app and API port (Media Ops uses 8484)

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database: every Downvote, decision and setting. Keep it on the cache pool (an exclusive appdata share, or /mnt/cache/appdata/media-review): SQLite is unreliable through /mnt/user's FUSE layer otherwise.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The https address friends open, e.g. https://review.example.com (the Cloudflare Tunnel public hostname). Plex sign-in comes back here.

Config.Name: Plex address
Config.Description: Plex as this container reaches it: its container name on the shared network, or the server's LAN IP if Plex runs on host networking

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Your (the server owner's) Plex token: Plex Web → any item → ⋯ → Get Info → View XML, the X-Plex-Token in the URL

Config.Name: Tautulli address
Config.Description: Tautulli as this container reaches it

Config.Name: Tautulli API key
Config.Description: Tautulli → Settings → Web Interface → API (tick Enable API)

Config.Name: Sync every (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to read Plex libraries and Tautulli play history

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as
